en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of the interior of a stylish dining room, likely from a hotel or classic restaurant. There are many tables with white tablecloths, each set for guests, and decorated with flower vases. Chandeliers hang from the ceiling, and artwork and mirrors decorate the walls. The reverse side provides structured space for writing and address. Several printed inscriptions reference 'Hotel Rasmussen', 'Bad Pyrmont', and a 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
